scope: Selected-contrast AS read support, selected-contrast Landscape eligibility, and independently recorded bulk differential-result selection. Whole-cohort network input has its own independently approved policy in network-input.v1.json; this bulk register does not define or modify that policy.

policy_change.scope: Require informative-count support in every expected sample; remove the former descriptive replicate-consistency and approximate-SE gates from active choices.

read_gate.quantifier: every expected sample in both numerator and denominator of each selected contrast
input_contract: Both declared contrast arms are nonempty.
Expected sample IDs and ordered count-slot identities resolve unambiguously to the selected contrast.

Every expected sample has actual numeric finite nonnegative IJC/SJC and a finite PSI observation in its defined [0,1] range; the three vectors have the expected length. This is input validity, not an extra stability threshold.
Missing columns, missing samples, incorrect array lengths, malformed values, duplicate/ambiguous mappings and non-finite counts cannot pass.
Valid zero counts are computable support failures; unavailable counts are not replaced by zero.
An absent arm or empty list cannot pass by vacuous truth.
read_gate.aggregation: logical AND over the per-sample >=10 results in both arms; no group averaging, summing over replicates, selecting a supported subset or pooling contrasts
read_gate.missing_or_invalid_input: block or record unavailable with an explicit reason; never passing support
read_gate.biological_design_boundary: Passing counts does not establish adequate biological replication, power or native-model eligibility.
read_gate.input_validity_boundary: Finite PSI in [0,1], finite nonnegative IJC/SJC, complete expected vector lengths and declared sample mapping are validity requirements; they do not add a replicate-consistency or approximate-SE threshold.

thresholds.rationale: Published rMATS application precedent; inclusive boundary is a declared implementation choice, not a universal biological boundary.

thresholds.unit: PSI fraction; 0.10 is ten percentage points
thresholds.rationale: Observed-effect selection; not a new rMATS cstat null hypothesis.
Not the DESeq2 results() alpha default; selection does not refit or re-optimize independent filtering.
Observed twofold gate, not a native test proving the true effect exceeds this value.

thresholds.unit: original gene/transcript adjusted statistic, endpoint preserved
thresholds.rationale: For stageR the target must match the original adjustment target; changing the target requires repeating stage-wise adjustment.
Preserve native testing unit; selecting a gene with a significant bin is not a new gene-level FDR.

thresholds.unit: IJC + SJC for one expected sample in the declared JC/JCEC mode
thresholds.scope: every expected sample in both arms of each selected contrast
thresholds.rationale: Kuijper et al. require every sample to have at least ten informative junction reads. Applying the same count threshold to JCEC is a declared Katana extension, not directly validated by that paper.

stable_event.meaning: all expected samples pass the active count gate

stable_significant.meaning: active count gate AND native significance/observed-effect selection

native_statistic_policy.DESeq2_selection: does not refit independent filtering, shrinkage or a thresholded-effect model
native_statistic_policy.stageR_target: must match source adjustment target; guard not yet implemented
native_statistic_policy.DEXSeq_unit: exon/bin evidence remains distinct from gene-level adjustment

reporting_requirements: active policy ID and count threshold
expected numerator/denominator sample IDs and sample counts
native significance settings and adjusted-value units

implementation_binding.expected_sample_scope: production project loader resolves every declared contrast-arm sample and records the expected sizes
implementation_binding.selected_contrast_landscape: all selected samples and all included selected-contrast event rows must satisfy support; no OR rescue
implementation_binding.evidence_scope: Local implementation and source-identity checks passed; these are not new experimental-data acceptance or biological validation. The original native statistical results remain unchanged.

result_columns.passes_data_usability: valid correctly sized PSI/IJC/SJC vectors for both arms
result_columns.passes_read_counts: all expected count slots meet IJC+SJC>=10
result_columns.stable_significant: read support AND native significance/observed-effect selection

selected_contrast_landscape.sample_matrix_rule: Every selected sample requires valid PSI and finite nonnegative informative counts >=10.
selected_contrast_landscape.row_rule: All included event rows from the selected contrasts must be measurement_eligible.
